name: ask-user
title: Ask the user
description: ask_user requests native Agent approval for one nonblank yes/no question up to 2000 characters. No item tables; native approval parts and core receipts hold state. Answer through core respond; use core send for freeform answers.
docs: Register createAskUserTool() on an agevex Agent with host authorize/authorizeExecution. Requires the host's existing agevex package. Responses must use core respond, never native approveToolCall directly. See /docs/tools/ask-user.
